releases.notes:
## New

- Show which floor drops are quest items vs loot `(EXTRA ONLY)`
- Show Scrappy food preferences `(EXTRA ONLY)`, and feeding progress
- Added colored Gem Pedestal markers that clear when placement or the open door is confirmed
- Added model glow for Rockmite mounds, Hideons, Duplicos and Bloodbats `(26.2 ONLY)`
- Added confirmed Rockmite mound hit progress

## Changes & Improvements

- Separate Floor Drop Loot and Floor Drop Quest Items controls, with per-item Always Active choices
- Hide surplus quest items once enough are held or their objective is complete, including outside Sparkling Mode
- Optionally list remaining floor-drop types separately in the Missing HUD
- Consolidated Safe Mode settings and preserved existing settings through migration; new Extra prediction features are enabled by default, while Regular builds always enforce Safe Mode
- Improved marker depth, floor-face colors, and shared settings controls
- Expanded opt-in developer diagnostics, entity research and performance profiling

## Fixes

- Fixed capture-marker ownership issues affecting nearby Gemzies and Duplicos
- Fixed sleeping Wumpa detection and brief unwanted vanilla critter nametags
- Added missing Wumpa, Scrappy feeding and Hunter dialogue filters
- Corrected shared Sparkling check colors and objective count colors
- Adjusted the New Year contest countdown for the observed delayed scoring window

## Downloads

Choose one jar for your Minecraft version:

`safariutils-3.3.0+mc26.1.2.jar`
`safariutils-3.3.0-extra+mc26.1.2.jar`
`safariutils-3.3.0+mc26.2.jar`
`safariutils-3.3.0-extra+mc26.2.jar`

Regular jars use Safe Mode; Extra includes Safe Mode toggles that when turned off, provide information the player cannot directly see and may not be safe to use; 26.1.2 builds have received less testing compared to 26.2.

releases.notes:
## New

- Added Personal Bests for biome and All Uniques clears, grouped by Solo, Duo, Trio and Squad contributors (see `/safari stats`)
- Added Personal bests for Gemzie, Doomspiral, Wumpa and Macaw catches (see `/safari stats`)
- Added Emerald Dye tracking and profit with relevant Auction pricing

## Changes & Additions

- Combined detailed run information and completion times into History and PB run views, with individual catch and shard breakdowns
- Automatically sync new Sparkling ownership and higher duplicate totals from player lookups without lowering saved collections
- Refined stats, collection and lookup layouts, colors, special themes and progress effects
- Added selectable [SafariUtils], [Safari] and [SU] client-message prefixes
- Added cached auction history and source-aware fallback estimates when current listings are unavailable

## Fixes & Improvements

- Preserved history-based Runs Since Unique and Runs Since Sparkling values after API refreshes
- Fixed lookup refresh controls, shared Sparkling cleanup and PB eligibility for clears you did not contribute to
- Reconciled Gimmiegold quotas with held coins and confirmed spawns, excluding discarded unused coins
- Smoothed moving recatch markers using frame interpolation while keeping absent-body pins fixed
- Kept unknown or empty party inventories out of the objective HUD
- Improved shared settings controls, focus handling and diagnostics; retained existing saved settings and run history

## Downloads

Choose one jar for your Minecraft version:

- `safariutils-3.2.0+mc26.1.2.jar`
- `safariutils-3.2.0-extra+mc26.1.2.jar`
- `safariutils-3.2.0+mc26.2.jar`
- `safariutils-3.2.0-extra+mc26.2.jar`

Regular jars use Safe Mode; Extra includes Safe Mode toggles that when turned off, provide information the player cannot directly see and may not be safe to use; 26.1.2 builds have received less testing compared to 26.2.
